text.description_html:
Don-Jo LP-307-630, Storefront Door Security Latch Guard

Protect your storefront door from tampering and latch prying with this stainless steel security latch protector plate. No special tools required for installation.

This stainless steel security door latch protector is 7" high and designed specifically for store front doors with Adams Rite type Mortise Deadlatch, Mortise Deadbolt or Mortise Hookbolt. The mounting bolt & rivet go through the door and are attached on the inside with the included fasteners.

Non-Handed, reversible for left or right hand outswinging doors. Fits over lock cylinder so the Mortise Lock Cylinder does not require removal when installing.

Specifications for the Don-Jo LP-307-630 Security Latch Guard:

  • Plate Height: 7"
  • Plate Width: 2-5/8"
  • Plate Thickness: 1/8"
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Offset: 3/8"
  • Non-Handed (reversible)
  • Fasteners: 5/16-18 x 2-1/4" Carriage bolt with Acorn nut and washer, plus drive-in rivet.
  • Don-Jo LP-307 Security Plate Dimensions (PDF)

Note: You need 2-3/4" clearance between the top of your exterior door handle, to the bottom of your lock cylinder, so the latch guard plate does not hit your handle. For doors with less than 2-3/4" clearance use Don-Jo GLP-307 Latch Guard.

*Sold Individually.
